verdicts.reason: Both scramble the bullet list into the wrong order (1,4,3,2), make the first bullet larger than the rest, wedge the grocer line between bullets, run the headline almost to the canvas edges, and put text over the pink circles. A at least keeps the CTA after the product, though it leaves a large empty band and pushes the logo to the bottom. B puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks the reading order and fights it for attention, and it also leaves a big gap above the oversized logo pill at the bottom.
